instrument.model: Brody-q over canonical spacings, with a near-coincidence model

params.name: abs_jump
params.why: what counts as a large jump; inherited from v2 at 0.05 and swept here because the offset's meaning should not depend on it

params.name: fixed_window
params.why: the coverage window, fixed in alpha per brocot_event_layer's amendment 1; swept because O3's gain must not be a window effect

params.name: f_c
params.why: delta scales with f_c and so does the spacing scale s, so kappa is dimensionless and f_c cancels from the prediction

params.name: spacing_statistic
params.why: the median is the scale the smallest spacings are anomalous RELATIVE TO; a mean would be dragged by the anomaly itself

CV(normalised) / CV(raw offset).name: CV(normalised) / CV(raw offset)
CV(normalised) / CV(raw offset).why: a ratio of two coefficients of variation; 0 if normalising collapses the spread entirely, and bounded well under 5 by the observed spreads

same ratio with the spacing scale SHUFFL.name: same ratio with the spacing scale SHUFFLED
same ratio with the spacing scale SHUFFL.why: the same ratio under a permutation null

coverage gain from predicted offsets.name: coverage gain from predicted offsets
coverage gain from predicted offsets.why: a difference of two coverages each in [0,1]

composed.label: MARKERS_ARE_THE_WRONG_OBJECT_COARSELY_AT_CV(normalised) / CV(raw offset)_AND_BY_same ratio with the spacing scale SHUFFLED
